1.0.5.en: Added API token authentication with secure token generation, token visibility controls, and Bearer or URL token support. Added Settings, API, and Information tabs with localized explanations. Added support for GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, and OPTIONS, route normalization, JSON validation, CORS handling, and improved settings layout.

1.5.0.en: Added repeatable countdown rounds with round tokens in the zero trigger.

1.6.0.en: Combined the HTTP API, Gmail email, countdown timers, and iCal calendars in one app. Added calendar synchronization, event Flow cards, local events, and iCal settings.
